discrepancy_ledger.root_cause: Clerical transcription/typing error in Phase 8 completion report text. The executable calculation in growthIntelligence.mjs:getRollingThirtyDaysStatistics() correctly computed 586 from empirical_daily_statistics.json (532 August + 54 September = 586). The author of the report accidentally typed 436 into the markdown text.

Dual-source architecture drift. In Phase 6, UtlSearchConsoleAdapter queried GSC with a 6-day property-level window (Aug 28 to Sep 2) and received 506 impressions (126+131+131+64+25+29 = 506), which was stamped onto single date 2026-09-04 in daily_statistics.json. statisticsAggregator.mjs:getMonthlyStatistics() read daily_statistics.json where Sep 1-3 were excluded as synthetic contaminated, leaving only Sep 4 (506). Reconstructed empirical daily GSC queries with date dimension show true September impressions are Sep 1: 25 and Sep 2: 29 (sum = 54), while Sep 3 and Sep 4 are pending GSC 48-72h reporting lag (null).

Dual-source architecture drift. In Phase 6, UtlGA4Adapter queried GA4 for 7daysAgo to yesterday (Aug 28 to Sep 3) and received 27 sessions (10+1+4+3+6+1+2 = 27), which was stamped onto Sep 4 row in daily_statistics.json; Phase 8 report cited 36 sessions. In contrast, authoritative date-dimensioned GA4 queries show Sep 1: 6, Sep 2: 1, Sep 3: 2, Sep 4: 1 (sum = 10 sessions). Direct monthly GA4 runReport query for 2026-09 independently confirmed exactly 10 sessions and 10 unique users.
Daily empirical page views are Sep 1: 8, Sep 2: 1, Sep 3: 3, Sep 4: 1 (sum = 13 views). Direct monthly GA4 query confirmed 13 views. Phase 8 report cited 42 (or 30 in daily_statistics.json).
Reconciled to canonical GA4 September sessions (10 sessions achieved, 990 remaining). Strict governance preserved: internal business benchmark only, is_google_requirement: false.
Authoritative external daily sum: 0 + 21 + 59 + 126 + 131 + 131 + 64 = 532 impressions. 100% verified.
Authoritative external daily sum: 13 + 34 + 19 + 10 + 1 + 4 + 3 = 84 sessions. 100% verified.
84 August sessions + 10 September sessions = 94 sessions across all 11 empirical days. 100% verified.
139 August views + 13 September views = 152 views across all 11 empirical days. 100% verified.
532 August impressions + 54 September impressions = 586 impressions. Sep 3 and Sep 4 are pending GSC 48-72h lag. 100% verified.

checklist_categories.name: High-Quality, Original Content & Value
checklist_categories.description: Site must provide unique, value-adding content that gives users a reason to visit and return.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: 420 functional, interactive utilities with zero placeholder tools; rich technical FAQs and canonical metadata.
checklist_categories.evidence: 420 live interactive tools verified with 100% test execution pass (417 automated passes, 3 human-validated).

checklist_categories.name: Google Publisher Policies Compliance
checklist_categories.description: Must comply with Google Publisher Policies (no illegal content, intellectual property infringement, deceptive navigation).
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: Clean utility implementations, no deceptive redirects, strict tool integrity.
checklist_categories.evidence: Audited codebase; zero deceptive layouts or prohibited content.

checklist_categories.name: Domain & Site Ownership Verification
checklist_categories.description: Publisher must own or have administrative rights to the domain.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: Google Search Console DNS domain verification active for sc-domain:utl.tools.
checklist_categories.evidence: GSC authenticated query active on sc-domain:utl.tools (GSC API verified).

checklist_categories.name: Technical Crawlability & Site Architecture
checklist_categories.description: Site must have clean navigation, robots.txt, dynamic sitemap, and accessible URLs for Googlebot.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: robots.ts and sitemap.ts generating all 467 routes; canonical URLs on all pages.
checklist_categories.evidence: Next.js SSG build produces 467 static pages + robots.txt + sitemap.xml. Canonical SEO verified.

checklist_categories.name: Authoritative Traffic Measurement
checklist_categories.description: Site must maintain real, truthful traffic measurement without synthetic inflation or invalid traffic.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: GA4 live measurement active; zero synthetic traffic multipliers.
checklist_categories.evidence: Phase 1-6 remediation established zero synthetic multipliers; GA4 Property 551527574 verified.

checklist_categories.name: Originality & Substantial Usability
checklist_categories.description: Tools must not simply scrape or mirror third-party content without independent functionality.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: Client-side execution logic in React/TypeScript, independent computation.
checklist_categories.evidence: 420 standalone interactive tools executing locally in browser.

checklist_categories.name: Navigation & User Experience
checklist_categories.description: Clear visual hierarchy, fast load times, accessible design, mobile responsive.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: Tailwind CSS responsive design, dark/light themes, search modal, category hierarchy.
checklist_categories.evidence: Verified responsive layouts and component mounting across all 420 tools.

checklist_categories.name: Privacy Policy & User Consent (GDPR/CPRA)
checklist_categories.description: Publishers must have a clear privacy policy and cookie consent mechanism where required.
checklist_categories.evaluation_criteria: Dedicated privacy policy route and consent disclosure for analytics/telemetry.
checklist_categories.evidence: Telemetry contract enforces zero PII, but dedicated user-facing /privacy page should be formally reviewed before submission.
